name: blackswan-xsection
description: The CROSS-SECTIONAL long/short screen (B1 §1) — a deliberately crude, deterministic ranking rule over a pre-registered multi-asset universe, run to FALSIFY the 3-4 week multi-asset env build cheaply. It asks 'will A outperform B?' rather than 'will this market go up?', because across 264 measured single-asset cells every apparent win was exposure reduction (mean beta 0.19, symmetric up/down capture), not directional skill. Ranks the universe by trailing return and trades one end against the other — long the top-k / short the bottom-k by default, or the exact inversion under signal='reversal' — equal-weight, rebalanced every N bars, charged fees on turnover both ways. Benchmark for return_vs_hold_pct is the EQUAL-WEIGHT UNIVERSE BASKET, not a single asset. Produces no model; its cells are side-experiment evidence, kept in their own record type so they never mix with the single-asset RL run store.

universe.description: The PRE-REGISTERED symbol universe ranked against itself. US-session instruments only — mixing 24/7 crypto onto a session calendar is the hardest alignment case and is deferred to §2 rather than fudged. Choosing symbols after seeing results is selection-on-test, so this list is fixed and never tuned on results.

lookback.description: Trailing bars used to rank the universe (the formation window), on either signal. Must be >= 1: a non-positive window inverts the ranking into a forward ratio and reads the future, so it is refused rather than run.

signal.description: Which END of the trailing-return rank is bought: 'momentum' longs the top k and shorts the bottom k (the published rule, and the behaviour of every cell run before this lever existed); 'reversal' is the exact rank inversion — long the bottom k, short the top k. It exists because the 96-cell momentum screen failed its gate with its worst window by a wide margin being stk-2023 at mean -63.50%, and 2023 was a documented momentum-crash year in which the beaten-down names this rule SHORTS were precisely the ones that ripped. A loss that large is structure with the sign flipped, not noise, and the opposite sign has never been measured. Nothing else about the screen changes, so a reversal cell is directly comparable to its momentum twin.

k.description: How many symbols to hold on each side — the top k against the bottom k, with `signal` deciding which end is the long leg. A universe with fewer than 2k rankable symbols would need to hold a name long and short at once, so the screen declines to trade instead.

rebalance_days.description: Bars between re-rankings. Turnover — and therefore cost — scales with this, which is the term that killed the single-asset signal edge.

long_only.description: Drop the short leg (hold only the top k). The long/short book is NET FLAT by construction; long-only reintroduces the market beta the fork exists to remove, so this is the reference arm, not the thesis.

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost, charged on both entries and exits.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample span is ACCOUNTED. The ranking may look back into the train span for its formation window, but only the test window's P&L is reported.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the screen is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept (three identical cells would fake replication).
